name: INCLO Google TV 4K
summary: INCLO Google TV 4K ships with ad auto-installs, telemetry and preloads. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This INCLO set is built by KTC and runs Google TV on Android 11. The list is short: ad and auto-install services, one telemetry service and a few maker and Google preloads. The stock Google TV home screen is also on the list, but it only goes once a replacement home screen is installed.

It was tested on one unit for one day, with HDMI game consoles, voice, casting and the gear button checked on the real remote, plus a restart. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: All the Realtek TV and input parts
KTC factory parts that handle remote keys (never opened)
Voice search and the remote service
notes: After the stock home screen is switched off, the remote's Netflix and YouTube buttons do nothing.
The setup helper owned the Wi-Fi network from first setup. Forget the network and rejoin it in Settings first, or the TV may drop off Wi-Fi.
With the new home screen's key helper on, a held volume key moves one step per press.

faq.q: Will casting still work on my INCLO TV?
faq.a: Yes. Chromecast is kept, and casting from an iPhone through YouTube still worked after a restart.

faq.q: Do the Netflix and YouTube buttons still work?
faq.a: Not once the stock home screen is off. They only talk to it. Everything else on the remote kept working.

faq.q: Does it have a way back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything in the app turns every app back on in one tap, and puts the old home screen back if you changed it.
